answer: I ran one Bell-state circuit on garnet:mock with 100 shots. The circuit put H on qubit 0, a CNOT from qubit 0 to qubit 1, and measured both qubits. The job ID is 01a15f16-dda0-737e-aac3-df4a2bce044e. The counts were 00: 23, 01: 22, 10: 27, 11: 28. The results are close to uniform and show no Bell correlation. The mock backend most likely returns random results instead of simulating the circuit, so this spread is expected and does not mean the circuit is wrong. The job used no credits. The script is at /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_1a6926f8-f6c-22/scratch/bell.py. It reads IQM_TOKEN from .env into the environment, because iqm-client rejects a token passed as an argument and an environment variable at the same time.
